architecture.title: Chimera II OS
architecture.subtitle: 8192-bit ISA · deterministic kernel primitives · DMA/IOMMU-aware I/O · Aurora/Wayland
domains: 284 defined opcodes (0x0001–0x011C); canonical 16-byte fetch ABI; core arithmetic/control execution
Deterministic priority scheduler, task state transitions, host virtual-memory mapping model and syscall boundary
Versioned CRC-protected BootInfo ABI; UEFI 2.11 / ACPI 6.6 are the platform baseline; loader remains next-stage work
Explicit device DMA masks, mapping tokens, sync/unmap lifecycle; hardware IOMMU backend remains future work
Zero-copy architecture with explicit packet ownership; real NIC rings and full TCP/IP remain P1
Wayland 1.49 protocol baseline and Vulkan 1.4.x interoperability target; compositor backend remains staged
Unified filesystem boundary, snapshots and transactional research storage; durable on-disk implementation remains P2
Capability and privilege boundaries, signed/measured boot design, W^X and DMA isolation requirements
Bounded recurrent-state and knowledge-bus research components; not represented as AGI or biological equivalence
Host-oriented compatibility architecture; native binary conformance remains a staged milestone
